definitions.gloss: to gather together; to collect; to scrape together
definitions.explanation: To bring various things or people together from different places. Often implies gathering miscellaneous or disparate items rather than a neat, organized collection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}めた。
⟦{残|のこ}り{物|もの}→残り物：18299_nokorimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}めて⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I scraped together the leftovers and made dinner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}めて⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: They assembled a team of experts gathered from around the country to form an emergency response unit.

notes:
Ichidan verb (⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧). Transitive — takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the things gathered.

The compound combines ⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ (to bring near) and ⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ (to collect). Often carries a nuance of assembling things hastily or from scattered sources, unlike ⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ alone which is more neutral.

The noun form {寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}め means 'a motley collection' or 'hodgepodge,' often with a slightly negative tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}める (to gather information from various sources)
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}める (to round up people)
- ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}める (to scrape together funds)
